- Pen test: we maintain a one-page executive summary that contains findings and remediation posture. Full technical report contains vulnerability details and is restricted. We can share the exec summary by 8/16.
- ISO27001 statement: validated and available today.
- Security deck: Vanessa — the version attached is cleared for sharing; Mina and Camila helped update the notes for SSO, KMS, and private deployment controls.

I will upload the redacted SOC2 and the pen-test exec summary to the shared Drive folder and notify once uploaded. If HealthSync requires a live walkthrough of the deck or a short Q&A with our security team, we can schedule a 30-min slot next week.
